title: Requirement Specification Structure
description: JSON representation of the formal structure from Li & Zheng (2025), Equation 1: <Pre-conditions [Previous Step]; Actor; Action; Business Objects; [To actor]; [Post-conditions]>

useCaseId.description: Unique identifier for the use case (e.g., 'UC-01')

steps.description: Ordered sequence of structured requirement steps

sourceRequirements.description: Parser-owned original source lines; optional for legacy artifacts.

structuredStep.description: A single requirement normalized into the formal structure (Eq. 1)

sourceRequirementId.description: Originating parser requirement ID; optional for legacy artifacts.

sourceText.description: Exact original source line reattached by code; optional for legacy artifacts.

precondition.description: Prerequisite state or condition for this step; null when the producer prompt has no precondition to report

previousStep.description: Explicit reference to the prior step in sequence; null for the first step in a flow

businessObject.description: The real-world business entity being acted upon (e.g., 'Order', NOT attributes like 'buyer name')

toActor.description: Recipient of the action, if directed toward another actor; null when the action has no recipient

postcondition.description: State that holds after successful execution of this step; null when the producer prompt has no postcondition to report

refUseCaseId.description: Pointer to an existing use case if this step is defined elsewhere (Eq. 2 simplified form); null when the step does not delegate

flowType.description: Which flow this step belongs to

deviationPoint.description: For alternative/exception steps: the basic flow step this deviates from (e.g., '3' for step 3a1); null for basic-flow steps

rejoinPoint.description: For alternative/exception steps: the basic flow step to rejoin after this flow completes; null if it terminates the use case
